notes.title: Patch Bug 1.0.17
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Gameplay Improvements


 Level Issues Resolved: Fixed various bugs across levels that were causing gameplay interruptions and unintended obstacles.
 Level Progress Fix: Addressed an issue where players' progress wasn’t updating correctly after completing certain levels.
 Camera Issue Fixed: Resolved a bug causing the camera to behave unexpectedly in certain views or angles, ensuring a smoother experience.
